Challenging question:

If you wrapped a steel cable exactly once around the Moon’s equator at surface level, then wanted to lift it uniformly 1 metre all the way around (so it now forms a perfect circle 1 m above the surface), how much extra length would you have to splice into the cable?  
(Assume the Moon is a perfect sphere 3 475 km in diameter and give the answer to the nearest centimetre.)
